description: テスト条件をテストベース／ステークホルダー／リスク／ガイドワードの4系統から導出させ、要件ID×テスト条件の双方向カバレッジ・観点カテゴリの未使用・条件IDの重複/欠番・優先度未設定・derivedFrom の未解決参照・重点クラス(SWC-01)ステークホルダーの条件紐づけと優先度引き下げ理由の有無を決定的に検査する。観点カタログ・ガイドワード辞書・リスク分析フレームに基づく追加洗い出しは呼び出し側LLMへの指示として返す。既存のテスト条件一覧を testConditions に渡せば、既存成果物のレビューとしても同じ決定的検査を実行できる。下流ツールの入力形式そのままの引き渡しJSONを `emitHandoverPayload: true` で出力し、受け側の算出ロジックで往復照合した結果を併記する。

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

coverageCriteria.description: Explicitly declared coverage criteria; a default set is emitted when omitted

emitHandoverPayload.description: If true, emits the full downstream-ready payload JSON. Default false: only the reconciliation summary, counts and the non-generatable field list are emitted.

idPrefix.description: Test condition ID prefix used for gap detection (default TC-)

personas.description: Stakeholders / personas referenced by derivedFrom when source is stakeholder; described with the Demographics / Says&Thinks / Goals / PainPoint quadrants

concerns.description: Known concerns of this persona (legacy field; prefer painPoints)

demographics.description: Demographics quadrant: age range, occupation, usage environment, IT literacy, etc.

goals.description: Goals quadrant: what this persona wants to achieve

painPoints.description: Pain Point quadrant: frustrations and obstacles this persona faces

saysAndThinks.description: Says & Thinks quadrant: what this persona says and thinks in the target context

stakeholderWeighting.description: Stakeholder weighting (influence x interest) result from the persona journey frame

excludedByScreening.description: Whether this stakeholder was screened out in SWS-04

exclusionReason.description: Reason for screening out; required when excludedByScreening is true

handlingClassId.description: Declared handling class id (SWC-01..SWC-03); cross-checked against the frame matrix

influence.description: Influence axis value taken from the frame levels (SW-INFLUENCE); omit when unevaluated

interest.description: Interest axis value taken from the frame levels (SW-INTEREST); omit when unevaluated

rationale.description: Facts backing the chosen axis values (at least one required)

score.description: Declared stakeholderScore; cross-checked against influence x interest

perspectiveCategoryIds.description: If provided, restrict the perspective coverage check to these category ids

priorityCriteria.description: Explicitly declared priority criteria; the risk frame default is emitted when omitted

requirementIds.description: Requirement/feature IDs that test conditions must cover (coverage matrix rows)

requirementSources.description: Requirement id -> test basis source location map, typically taken from analyze_requirements section 2.6

label.description: Display label, e.g. 'EH-100 Ticket gate startup'

requirementId.description: Requirement id this source location belongs to

risks.description: Risks referenced by derivedFrom when source is risk

changeCategory.description: Change category related to this risk

likelihoodDetail.description: Optional likelihood sub-axes (RA-USAGE / RA-PRONENESS); falls back to likelihood when omitted

defectProneness.description: Defect proneness factor sub-axis (1..5, 3 is standard)

pronenessFactorIds.description: Proneness factor ids (RA-PF-xx) backing a defectProneness deviation

pronenessRationale.description: Rationale text when defectProneness deviates from the standard value 3

riskCategoryId.description: Risk category id from the risk analysis frame, e.g. RC-04

severity.description: Optional severity sub-axes (RA-SEV-01..04); falls back to impact when omitted

ripple.description: Ripple impact to related features sub-axis (1..5)

sourceRefs.description: Explicit source locations in the test basis backing this risk

label.description: Display label, e.g. 'EH-100 Ticket gate startup'

stakeholderImpacts.description: Per-stakeholder impact levels for the risk x stakeholder impact matrix

stakeholderFrameId.description: Stakeholder frame id from the risk analysis frame, e.g. RSF-01

stakeholderLabel.description: Stakeholder label outside the risk analysis frame

targetIds.description: Feature/screen ids this risk applies to

testConditions.description: Test conditions to inspect; source and derivedFrom are mandatory metadata

changeCategory.description: Change category of the target, used as the change weight

derivedFrom.description: Requirement IDs / risk IDs / persona IDs this condition was derived from (required). Plain id string, or {kind, id} to disambiguate across requirement/risk/stakeholder/guideword namespaces

likelihoodDetail.description: Optional likelihood sub-axes (RA-USAGE / RA-PRONENESS); falls back to likelihood when omitted

defectProneness.description: Defect proneness factor sub-axis (1..5, 3 is standard)

pronenessFactorIds.description: Proneness factor ids (RA-PF-xx) backing a defectProneness deviation

pronenessRationale.description: Rationale text when defectProneness deviates from the standard value 3

perspectiveCategoryId.description: Perspective category id from the catalog, e.g. TPC-03

priorityDeviationReason.description: Reason if the declared priority deviates from the risk-based derived priority

purposeIds.description: Test purpose ids from derive_test_purposes this condition was derived from

rationale.description: Additional note on how the condition was derived

recommendedTechniques.description: Recommended technique ids to hand over to generate_test_cases

riskCategoryId.description: Risk category id from the risk analysis frame, e.g. RC-04

severity.description: Optional severity sub-axes (RA-SEV-01..04); falls back to impact when omitted

ripple.description: Ripple impact to related features sub-axis (1..5)

source.description: Derivation line this condition came from (required)

sourceRefs.description: Explicit source locations in the test basis; takes precedence over requirementSources lookup

label.description: Display label, e.g. 'EH-100 Ticket gate startup'

target.description: Target of the condition (feature ID / screen ID)

testPurposes.description: Test purposes from derive_test_purposes, used to cross-check testConditions[].purposeIds bidirectionally

name: extract_test_conditions
title: Extract Test Conditions
